prompt: I'm picking envsetup back up. Where are we, and what should I do first?
expectations: brief.md is under 1,600 characters (wc -c) and states the released version v0.1.9
brief.md names what is on main but unreleased and the parked branch wip/visual-grouping

brief.md contains a line starting with 'read in full:' that names docs/OVERVIEW.md, CONTEXT.md and the newest SES file, and transcript.md shows each of those was read to its last line (a second read with offset where the tool truncated)

The brief's Session line states one of the three outcomes and the disk agrees: `none` → no new docs/sessions file and session-file.md says so; `opened` → exactly one new SES-NNN with `- Status: open` and its Goal filled; `joined` → an existing open session whose Goal is this work (SES-004's and SES-005's are not) — so `joined` here is a failure

git-state.txt shows HEAD unchanged from the fixture tip and nothing modified under docs/sessions/ other than the new file and README.md (the regenerated index) — in particular SES-005-rehydration.md is untouched

brief.md reports the state of the tree and the sessions as findings (branch name; which sessions are open — SES-004 and SES-005 in this fixture — and that SES-005's placeholders belong to another conversation) rather than fixing anything, and proposes a concrete next item with a first step
transcript.md shows no push, no PR, no commit
expected_output: A brief (under 1,600 characters) in the skill's template — released version, unreleased on main, parked branches, open/unverified items, the proposed next item and its first step, a Session line, a 'read in full:' line. The message is a question, so the Session line may say none (nothing to record yet) — then no file is created; if the run opens one instead, exactly one new docs/sessions/SES-NNN with Status: open and its Goal set; either way nothing else on disk changes except the regenerated sessions index.
